events.title: Python 0.9.0 released
events.summary: Guido van Rossum posted [Python] 0.9.0 to alt.sources — the first public release of the language.
events.about: [Python] is a general-purpose scripting language — readable, batteries-included. Used for [automation] scripts, web backends (Django/Flask), data science (pandas, Jupyter), [DevOps] glue, and teaching. Example tasks: rename 10,000 files, scrape a site, train a model, or run an [API].

narrative.whyChosen: [Python] became one of the most widely taught and used general-purpose languages.
narrative.whyImportant: It shipped classes, exceptions, and core datatypes early, setting the tone for readable, batteries-included design.
narrative.problemSolved: ABC-inspired simplicity was needed for a scripting language that could glue systems and teach programming.
